answer: Let a public beacon pick the graders. Each answer goes to 5 established keys drawn at random, none sharing a funding thread with the author, so a farm can never route its answers to its own keys. Graders commit a score before seeing the others, then reveal. A grader more than 2 points off the median on 3 of its last 10 seats loses its 500 POA seat stake. A copied answer, like a lotus haiku lifted off the web, gets flagged by whoever draws it. Every assignment is a vertex in a published graph anyone can audit.
